definitions.gloss: writing style; manner of writing; tone (of writing)
definitions.explanation: The distinctive way in which someone writes — encompassing tone, word choice, sentence rhythm, and overall manner. Often used when commenting on someone's article, letter, or essay to describe the feel of the prose rather than its content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧だ。
examples.english: His writing style is polite and careful.

examples.japanese: {新聞記事|しんぶんきじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: The writing style of the newspaper article conveys the author's stance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブログ→ブログ：05104_burogu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}きつけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Her blog has a distinctive writing style that draws many readers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{乗|の}り{気|き}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ようだ。
examples.english: Judging from the way the report is written, he doesn't seem very enthusiastic about this matter.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (the masu-stem of ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧, 'to write') + the suffix ⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ ('manner; style'). The suffix ⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ attaches to the stems of many verbs to produce a noun meaning 'the way someone does ~.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書|か}きぶり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧: careful/polite writing style
- {書|か}きぶり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧: a stiff/formal writing style
- {書|か}きぶり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧: a soft/gentle writing style
- {書|か}きぶり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge from how it is written
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり: a distinctive writing style
- ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり: the writing style of a report
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}きぶり: the way an article is written

USAGE:
- Focuses on the overall impression of a piece of writing — its tone and manner — rather than on specific features like grammar or vocabulary.
- Commonly used in media commentary, when someone analyzes the tone of a news story, blog post, letter, or report to infer the writer's intent or attitude.
- Can be applied to any written text: official documents, emails, social media posts, novels, journalistic articles.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: way of writing — broader and more neutral; can describe both technique (how to form characters) and style; the most common everyday term.
- ⟦{文体|ぶんたい}→文体：12931_buntai⟧: literary style — a more technical term used in linguistics and literary analysis to classify prose (e.g., {敬体|けいたい} vs. {常体|じょうたい}).
- ⟦{筆致|ひっち}→筆致：24365_hicchi⟧: literary touch; stroke of the pen — more literary/formal; emphasizes the finesse or brushstroke-like quality of a writer's prose.
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: prose; writing (as an object) — refers to the writing itself, not its style.

RELATED ぶり WORDS:
- ⟦{話|はな}しぶり→話しぶり：20735_hanashiburi⟧: manner of speaking
- ⟦{口|くち}ぶり→口ぶり：15424_kuchiburi⟧: tone (of speech); way of talking
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: work performance; way of working
- ⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: lifestyle; way of living
